programs.title: Bing MAIN
programs.desc: Bing teaches Charlie how to throw but accidentally knocks the fruit over. Flop thinks that Charlie did it, but after another mishap, Bing learns that it's best to say sorry for his own mistakes.

programs.title: Fizzy And Suds
programs.desc: Fizzy and Suds explore dinosaurs at the museum! They ride skeletons, meet scientists, fix bones, and find out how fossils tell us what dinosaurs ate and how they lived.

programs.title: Peppa Pig
programs.desc: Granddad Dog takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog with him when he delivers supplies to Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse, where Grampy enjoys the wide-open sky and has time to learn the banjo.

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: It's Express Yourself with Art Day! After some 'Hot Potato' fun, Lucia encourages The Wiggles to draw their feelings. Afterwards Lucia shares the idea of displaying their drawings in The Wiggly Art Gallery.

programs.title: Shaun the Sheep
programs.desc: Never meet your heroes. The Farmers Rock n' Roll idol is stranded at the farm when his limousine breaks down. Soon revealed as a spoilt pretender, Shaun decides to show him a lesson from the 'School of Rock'.

programs.title: The Adventures of Paddington
programs.desc: The kids decide to form a rock band with Paddington, but he is unsure of what instrument he should play and doesn't know what rock music is and fears they will break up before the grand performance in the park.
